in_sanskrit.name: Lakhya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace, Divine Play
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lakhya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Lakshya’, meaning goal or objective, Lakhya refers to the divine play or God's grace. In Hindu mythology, Lakshya is associated with the god Vishnu, symbolizing the power to set and achieve spiritual goals. The name evokes a sense of being guided by a higher power and embracing the journey of life.
